title: A little light follows you
description: A soft spring-driven light follows the pointer within a quiet card.
useCase: Add a subtle pointer enhancement to a featured card without moving its readable content.
interaction: Move your pointer across the card
reducedMotion: The light stays centered and subdued. Touch receives the same static treatment.
limitations: The light is decorative. Do not rely on hover to expose content or essential state.
look: Dark charcoal page with one rounded slate-green card carrying a faint dot grid, a soft pale-green glow near the top and a crosshair icon centred.
motion: Mouse movement over the card pulls a soft radial light after the pointer on a spring and brightens it in 0.2 s; leaving springs it back to centre, dimmed.
adapt: `x` and `y` are `useSpring` values (`stiffness: 160, damping: 26`) set in `onPointerMove` and reset to the card centre (`138`, `88`) on leave; the light is the `motion.div` radial gradient with hover opacity `0.75`. Replace the dot grid and icon with your content.
